summary: Aluminum 1200-series 1-side, 2-post pattern mount. A 32 mm diameter, 8 mm thick round boss carries a 14 mm center bore, four M4 threaded holes and four 4 mm clearance slots. Two 8 mm square posts, 30 mm apart overall, extend down to the mounting surface with a U-shaped 18 mm relief between them. The bore center sits 24 mm above the bottom surface.

mountingSurfaces.description: Bottom faces of the two posts, each with an M4 hole 7 mm deep, 24 mm apart; this is the mating surface to structure.
Front pattern face (+z side) with the 14 mm bore, four M4 holes and four 4 mm slots, centered 24 mm above the bottom surface. A 16 mm diameter, 1 mm deep counterbore surrounds the bore.

notes: Sizes are read from the printed drawing. Overall height is 40 mm, thickness 8 mm, and the legs are 30 mm wide. The 32 mm width comes from the bottom view and equals the round boss diameter (24 mm center height + 16 mm radius = 40 mm). The 18 mm post gap is U-shaped. Coordinates are centered on the bounding box, so the bore center is at y = +4 (24 mm above the bottom at y = -20). The four M4 holes lie on a square with 16 mm sides (radius about 11.3 mm). The four 4 mm slots lie on a 24 mm diagonal pattern, about 8.49 mm off-axis in each direction. The M4 thread depth in the pattern face is not stated, so those holes are marked non-through. The 4 mm slots are drawn as obround and are approximated here as round. The 1 mm deep, 16 mm diameter counterbore around the bore is not listed as a hole.
